messages:
maya.s: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw a recurring pattern of cross-region retries + elevated TLS handshake failures that correlate with recent LB routing changes. We need clear owners, timelines, and a prevention plan so this doesn't keep cropping up.

alex.k: Ack. Can you list the concrete remediation items?

maya.s: Sure. Proposed actions: 1) Pin fallback routing policy for customer-facing routes; 2) Add SNI hostname sanity checks to LB config validations; 3) Alert for cross-region retry ratio > 1% over 5m and a dashboard; 4) Canary TLS reconfiguration across 2 regions before full rollout; 5) Automation for auto-rollback of risky route changes. Assign owners?

paul.t: I can own the alert + dashboard (observability). Confirm metric: request.retry_ratio by route?

maya.s: Yes — request.retry_ratio per upstream/route. Start with 1% threshold and iterate.

carla.m: I have an existing sni_check tool that can be adapted. Draft snippet: 
```bash
# run sni validation against route table
python3 tools/sni_check.py --env prod --routes-file routes.json\```
I'll open a PR for automatic validation during deploy.

ops-josh: For auto-rollback, propose a lightweight controller that compares success rate pre/post-change and flips weights if retries spike. Need Eng Net signoff. I'll create the issue.

eng-net: Sounds reasonable. Please include a safe cooldown and a circuit breaker so we don't oscillate. Also recommend exporting route diffs daily for audit.

sre-bot: Action: add owners to follow-up board. Use /incidents create-followup 1769001234 to register tasks.

alex.k: I'll take routing pin and fallback mapping. ETA: Mon COB.

paul.t: Alerts ETA: 3 working days. Will create PR in observability repo and link here.

carla.m: SNI checks PR target: Thu EOD. Will include a small test harness for canary.

ops-josh: Issue opened for auto-rollback: https://issues.redwood/internal/ISS-1234 (runbook attached). I'll prototype the lambda this week.

maya.s: Great. Check-in cadence: fortnightly until 30 days with no recurrence. First check-in: Wed Jul 9 10:00am PT. Everyone paste progress updates here.

eng-net: Also adding a canary traffic generator to smoke TLS changes — will schedule and share results.

alex.k: I'll add explicit region-to-region fallback mapping to avoid silent cross-region failovers.

paul.t: Quick ops question: should we lower LB TLS handshake timeout to avoid retries? That might cut noise but could hurt slow clients.

carla.m: Agreed — don't change timeouts globally without canary. We'll test in canary and measure impact on the client success rate.

maya.s: Owner summary for the postmortem doc (I'll paste into the official postmortem): Alex K — routing pin & fallback mapping (Mon COB); Carla M — SNI validation + PR (Thu EOD); Paul T — alerts & dashboard (3 days); Eng-Net — canary + review; Ops-Josh — auto-rollback issue & runbook (prototype this week).

sre-bot: Follow-up tasks created: CID-3827, CID-3828, CID-3829.

ops-josh: I'll run a one-off smoke against the canary after Eng-Net schedules it and post results here.

maya.s: Thanks everyone. Please keep updates short and tag me for blockers. I'll mark follow-ups in the tracker by EOD. :thumbsup:
